import anndata as ad, pandas as pd
ref=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
q=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
rv=ref.obs['guide'].value_counts(); qv=q.obs['guide'].value_counts()
print('ref n guides',len(rv),'nonNT',len(rv)-rv.get('NT',0), 'total nonNT',rv.drop(index=[i for i in rv.index if i.startswith('NT')]).sum())
print('q n guides',len(qv),'nonNT',len(qv)-sum(i.startswith('NT') for i in qv.index), 'total nonNT',qv[~qv.index.str.startswith('NT')].sum())
print('ref nonNT count sum', ref.obs.loc[~ref.obs.guide.str.startswith('NT')].shape[0])
print('q nonNT count sum', q.obs.loc[~q.obs.guide.str.startswith('NT')].shape[0])
print('ref NT counts by guide', ref.obs[ref.obs.guide.str.startswith('NT')].guide.value_counts())
print('q NT counts by guide', q.obs[q.obs.guide.str.startswith('NT')].guide.value_counts())
# align nonNT sorted counts
r=rv[~rv.index.str.startswith('NT')].sort_values()
qq=qv[~qv.index.str.startswith('NT')].sort_values()
print(pd.DataFrame({'ref_guide':r.index,'ref_count':r.values,'query_guide':qq.index,'query_count':qq.values}).to_string())
PY"

from scipy import sparse
ref=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')

def prep(a):
    X=a.X
    if sparse.issparse(X): X=X.toarray()
    # library normalize to median? use log1p CPM
    lib=X.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)

        order=np.argsort(m)

import anndata as ad, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
ref=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
q=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')

def prep(a):
    X=a.X
    if sparse.issparse(X): X=X.toarray()
    lib=X.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    return np.log1p(X/lib*1e4), np.array(a.var_names), a.obs.guide.astype(str).values
RX,rgenes,rguides=prep(ref)
QX,qgenes,qguides=prep(q)
# align common vars, common order in ref (exclude target genes not in query)
common=np.intersect1d(rgenes,qgenes)
ri=np.array([list(rgenes).index(g) for g in common])
qi=np.array([list(qgenes).index(g) for g in common])
print('common',len(common))
def sig(X, genes, guide, common_idx):
    nt=X[np.array([g.startswith('NT') for g in guide])].mean(axis=0)
    sigs={}
    for g in sorted(set(guide)):
        if g.startswith('NT'): continue
        mask=guide==g

import anndata as ad, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.stats import rankdata
ref=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad'); q=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
targets=set(ref.obs['target_gene'].astype(str).unique())-{'NT'}
common=[g for g in ref.var_names if g in set(q.var_names) and g not in targets]
r=ref[:,common].copy(); q=q[:,common].copy()
def norm_log(a):
 X=a.X.astype(float).tocsr(); lib=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel(); sf=1e4/np.maximum(lib,1); X=sparse.diags(sf).dot(X); X.data=np.log1p(X.data); return X.toarray()
R=norm_log(r); Q=norm_log(q)

def diff_vecs(X,guide,nt):
 out={}; gu=sorted(set(guide))
 for g in gu:
  if g.startswith('NT'): continue
  out[g]=X[guide==g].mean(0)-nt
 return out
rd=diff_vecs(R,rguide,rnt); qd=diff_vecs(Q,qguide,qnt)

            # mean rank percentile of geneset in query diff (small diff = lower rank)
            ranks=rankdata(d, method='average')
            rankset=ranks[list(geneset)]
            scores.append((rankset.mean(),g,len(geneset)))
        scores.sort()
        print(label, [(g,round(s,0)) for s,g,n in scores[:10]])

import anndata as ad, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import scvi
import torch
sc.settings.verbosity=1
ref=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
q=ad.read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
targets=set(ref.obs['target_gene'].astype(str).unique())-{'NT'}
common=[g for g in ref.var_names if g in set(q.var_names) and g not in targets]
r=ref[:,common].copy(); q=q[:,common].copy()
r.obs['batch']='ref'; q.obs['batch']='query'
r.obs['label']=r.obs['target_gene'].astype(str).values
q.obs['label']='unknown'
adata=ad.concat([r,q], join='inner', index_unique=None, keys=None, label='batch')
# Need integer counts; X currently raw counts int64.
sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_counts=1)
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=3000, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch')
adata=adata[:, adata.var.highly_variable].copy()
print('adata', adata.shape)
scvi.model.SCANVI.setup_anndata(adata, batch_key='batch', labels_key='label', unlabeled_category='unknown')
model=scvi.model.SCANVI(adata, n_latent=20, n_layers=2)
model.train(max_epochs=100, early_stopping=True, batch_size=512, plan_kwargs={'lr':1e-3})
print('trained')
# predict
pred=model.predict(adata)
# actually predict labels for all? model.predict returns latent? use model.predict(adata, soft=False) maybe
# Let's get latent and train classifier
latent=model.get_latent_representation(adata)
adata.obsm['X_scANVI']=latent
ref_mask=adata.obs['batch'].values=='ref'
qmask=~ref_mask
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
clf=KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=20, weights='distance').fit(latent[ref_mask], adata.obs['label'].values[ref_mask])
pred_labels=clf.predict(latent[qmask])
q.obs['pred_label']=pred_labels
print('\\nPer query guide majority pred')
print(q.obs.groupby('guide', observed=True)['pred_label'].agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0] if len(x) else 'NA').to_string())
for target in ['PABPC1','NUDT21','LEO1']:
    sub=q.obs[q.obs.pred_label==target]
    print('\\ntarget',target, sub.guide.value_counts().head(10).to_dict())

import re, subprocess, itertools, numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
lines=[x.strip() for x in subprocess.check_output(['strings','-n','4','k562_hto_guide_segment.bin'], text=True).splitlines()]
pat=re.compile(r'"'^(?:[A-Z0-9]+-I'"\\d+|NT-I\\d+)"'$'"')
start=next(i for i,x in enumerate(lines) if pat.match(x))
hto_before=[x for x in lines[:start] if x.startswith('HTO-')]
guides=[x for x in lines if pat.match(x)]
hto=hto_before[-len(guides):]
selected=set(['CDC73-I2','CPSF1-I3','CPSF2-I1','CPSF3-I3','CPSF3L-I8','CPSF4-I8','CPSF6-I5','CPSF7-I1','CSTF1-I5','CSTF2-I4','CSTF3-I5','CTR9-I7','FIP1L1-I1','LEO1-I2','NUDT21-I3','PABPC1-I1','PABPN1-I2','PAF1-I6','PAPOLA-I3','PCF11-I5','PHF3-I5','RBBP6-I4','RPAP2-I2','RPRD1A-I5','RPRD1B-I1','SCAF1-I2','SCAF4-I4','SCAF8-I3','SCAF11-I3','SF3A1-I5','SRSF3-I1','SYMPK-I3','THOC5-I1']+[f'NT-I{i}' for i in range(1,11)])
by=defaultdict(Counter)
for h,g in zip(hto,guides):
    if g in selected: by[h][g]+=1
htos=list(by.keys())
qnt=np.array([119,175,152,90,117,158,150,82,104,277],float)
# query nonNT sorted descending
qnon=np.array([208,200,199,178,158,127,102,97,86,83,68,65,55,55,48,43,40,38,32,29,27,23,22,20,16,16,15,13,10,10,6,3],float)
def score(c):
    total=sum(c.values())
    nt=np.array([c[f'NT-I{i}'] for i in range(1,11)],float)
    scale_nt=(qnt@nt)/(nt@nt+1e-9) if nt.sum()>0 else 1
    err_nt=np.sqrt(np.mean((scale_nt*nt-qnt)**2))
    non=np.array(sorted([v for k,v in c.items() if not k.startswith('NT-')], reverse=True),float)
    # pad/truncate to 32? subset may have fewer nonNT labels; use top 32 only
    non=non[:32]
    if len(non)<32: non=np.pad(non,(0,32-len(non)))
    # scale all counts to query total
    scale_all=sum(qnt)+sum(qnon); scale_all/=total if total>0 else 1
    err_non=np.sqrt(np.mean((scale_all*non-qnon)**2))
    return err_nt, err_non, abs(total-(sum(qnt)+sum(qnon))), total, scale_nt
best=[]
for r in range(1,len(htos)+1):
    for comb in itertools.combinations(htos,r):
        c=Counter()
        for h in comb: c.update(by[h])
        e1,e2,dt,total,s=score(c)
        best.append((e1+e2*0.5, e1,e2,dt,total,comb,c))
# Sort by combined err
best_sorted=sorted(best,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2]))[:30]
for b in best_sorted:
    _,e1,e2,dt,total,comb,c=b
    print('err',round(b[0],2),'nt',round(e1,2),'non',round(e2,2),'total',total,'diff',dt,'comb',comb)
    print('  NT',[c[f'NT-I{i}'] for i in range(1,11)],'nonNT top',sorted([v for k,v in c.items() if not k.startswith('NT-')],reverse=True)[:15])
PY"
